run_unified_attention: run unified attention on QKV tensors with causal masking, sliding window, and optional softcap
run_kernel_unified_attention_2d: run the 2D Triton kernel for unified attention with block tables and per-token quantization
run_kernel_unified_attention_3d: run the 3D segmented Triton kernel for unified attention with parallel softmax segments
run_reduce_segments: run the reduce_segments kernel to merge segmented attention outputs into final output
run_prepare_kv_tile: prepare a KV cache tile by casting to Q dtype and applying per-token-head quantization scales
